indicesNarrative: Equities are enjoying a strong relief rally as the soft jobs report lowers the probability of an October Fed rate hike from over 60% down to ~20%. Tech (QQQ) and mega-caps (MGK) are leading the charge, while small caps (IWM) and mid caps (MDY) participate in the broader relief.
technicalsNarrative: Indices are attempting pull-back reclaims across the board led by Nasdaq momentum. While mega-cap tech and semiconductor leaders are testing or making new highs, traders should avoid chasing extended gap-ups and instead focus on tight consolidation breakouts with defined risk.
